read_only_client_command:
set -eu
export KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS='-Xms128m -Xmx256m'
test -f /home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/bin/client.properties
test -f /home/ssm-user/kafka_2.12-2.8.1/libs/aws-msk-iam-auth-2.3.0-all.jar
for topic in kitchen.sensor.validated kitchen.sensor.quarantine; do

done
